The '''Imperial Transfer Post''' was a location near [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]]. It was one of three spaceports that bordered the [[Inner Kuat Transfer Zone]] during the time of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==History==
This space station was reserved for Imperial use only, leading to trespassers being automatically targeted. In [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]] it was the site of a commissioning ceremony for the [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']], attended by [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]; [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]; [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Rufaan Tigellinus]]; and [[Admiral/Legends|Admirals]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]], [[Tandres]], [[Tavares]], and [[Kendal Ozzel/Legends|Kendal Ozzel]].
